emotional_tone: High-tech, immersive, professional yet edgy. A curated gallery for cutting-edge game assets.

headings.casing: uppercase for labels and small headings

layout_and_spacing.strategy_marketing: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Asymmetrical layouts mixing massive 3D visual blocks with tight typographic information. Grid spanning rules: 12-col base, overlapping content.
layout_and_spacing.strategy_dashboard: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. Dense, data-heavy, maximizing real estate. Strict 1px borders.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous scaling: p-6 to p-12 for main containers. Tight gaps (gap-4) for data, wide gaps (gap-12) for marketing sections.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Sharp to subtle. Use rounded-none or max rounded-md (6px-8px) to maintain the technical cyberpunk edge.

surfaces_and_effects.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl or backdrop-blur-2xl with bg-slate-900/60. MUST include a 1px inner stroke (e.g., border border-teal-500/20) to define edges.
surfaces_and_effects.glow_effects: Use drop-shadows mapped to brand colors on hover: drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(124,58,237,0.5)].
surfaces_and_effects.background_texture: Avoid flat #0F172A. Implement radial gradient overlays (e.g., bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-purple-900/20 via-slate-900 to-slate-900) or CSS noise for depth.

motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Framer Motion. Fade in with a slight upward translation (y: 20 -> 0) and smooth easing.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Buttons and cards should lift slightly (-translate-y-1), increase glow intensity, and shift border color to Primary (Purple) or Secondary (Teal).
motion_and_interaction.3d_integration: React Three Fiber (R3F) for the hero scene. WebGL canvas must load lazily or be wrapped in Suspense to prevent blocking. Include mouse-tracking rotation (parallax).
motion_and_interaction.particles: Implement TSParticles in the hero and footer backgrounds for the 'floating particles' effect, using subtle teal and purple colors.

component_strategy.buttons: Sharp corners or rounded-sm. Solid buttons use #7C3AED with hover state shifting to a lighter purple. Outline buttons use #14B8A6 border with text-teal-400.
component_strategy.cards: Cardless or flat surfaces with 1px border. Avoid generic Shadcn thick shadows; use 'Tracing Beam' glowing borders for premium assets.
component_strategy.inputs_and_forms: Shadcn UI customized. bg-slate-900, border-slate-700, focus:border-teal-500, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-teal-500.
component_strategy.3d_viewer: Asset Detail Page must feature a Three.js canvas replacing the traditional image gallery, with controls for rotate, zoom, wireframe toggle, and lighting adjustment.
component_strategy.icons: lucide-react (default for Shadcn) or @phosphor-icons/react. Stick to sharp, technical icons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text should be at least #94A3B8 (slate-400).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, 3D viewer controls) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

hero_background.description: Futuristic city neon night. Use as a heavily blurred/darkened background layer behind the R3F hero scene.

featured_assets.description: Computer generated robot asset. Use for 'Trending' or 'Featured' cards.
Sci-fi weapons grid. Use for Weapons category thumbnail.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: framer-motion, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, three, @tsparticles/react, @tsparticles/slim, react-icons (or lucide-react).
Apply fonts globally: '@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap");'. Map them in tailwind.config.js.
Build the navigation as a sticky, glassmorphic header with z-50.

For the Hero Section: implement an interactive 3D scene using React Three Fiber. If model loading is complex, use simple geometric primitive compositions (like a floating glowing crystal or cyber-cube) with Drei's <Float> and <Environment>.
Implement TSParticles for the background 'floating particles' in the hero and dark sections.
Ensure the Asset Detail Page includes a placeholder Three.js viewer box that toggles between modes (wireframe, lighting).
Do NOT use placeholder.com images. Strictly map the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs to the UI for thumbnails and avatars.
